status: Concept only; pending human review; not UE runtime

items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE polished high-end game VFX concept artwork for SSLM, an original Eastern-mythology stylized realistic PBR game. Wide 16:9 landscape art-director review board, sharp material detail, clean rendering, restrained exposure. This is concept art, NOT a real Unreal Engine screenshot.
Composition: left 70% a continuous three-quarter isometric gameplay view, camera about 30 degrees down, of a stone-paved oriental village courtyard with subtle moss, elegant timber buildings, gray stone balustrade, lush foliage, soft blue-hour ambient lighting and a few warm lanterns. Same viewpoint and scale for a paired fire/ice impact series. A silver neutral humanoid caster at lower left, a silver humanoid training target at upper right, both 180cm tall, well separated. Main focus is ONE projectile JUST HITTING the center of the target's chest, in the first 0.08-0.16 second of impact. Impact is attached to actual chest contact, NOT floating short of target, NOT at ground level. Target's head, shoulders, arms and legs remain recognizable. Left scene shows the full figures and enough courtyard, but target and impact large enough to read. No gore or injury.
Right 30%: a magnified crop/design detail of THE SAME contact burst at the same angle, including a small segment of silver chest armor to communicate contact; dark blue-gray neutral background, fine elegant vertical divider. This is a matching close-up, not a second unrelated explosion. Warm/cool light reflected on armor and a small area of paving, preserve background details and don't illuminate whole scene.
The incoming projectile's short residual wake is detached from caster: THREE tapered strands at staggered 0/60/120 degree phase, dying away behind impact, no beam connected to the hand. Broad 3D sculptural forms and nuanced energy flow, no flat VFX card look. Local air distortion visible as restrained bending of nearby edge details, no literal glass dome, no giant shockwave ring or full-screen distortion.
Clean elegant Chinese typography, large heading upper-left, small close-up caption upper-right, small footer lower-right. The footer reads EXACTLY "设计概念图 · 待人工审核 · 非UE实机". No editor controls, no fake performance statistics, no additional branding. No grain, no arbitrary noisy filigree, no harsh sharpen halos, no clipped white mass.
Primary request: redesign a FIREBALL HIT, continuous in style with a thick golden-orange rolling spherical fireball in flight.
At chest contact the ball compresses into a small, dense warm platinum-white ignition focus, only 5-8% of visible burst. Around this, a substantial asymmetrical amber-gold and golden-yellow fire bloom opens into 4-6 broad rolling lobes, with deep orange-red folds, beautiful curled flame tongues and clearly separated front/middle/back depth. Diameter about 90-110cm compared to the 180cm target, well-contained localized spell hit. Momentum fans flame forward and sideways around the chest, a little rebound backward along approach; no uniform circular flower, no tornado or fire disk. Dense luminous inner combustion volume with transparent overlapping edges kept limited; generous curved flame sheets have thickness and soft scalloped curls, subtle fine flowing veins nested within larger folds. White core small, gold middle, vermilion #F16B46/orange-red outer curls. Never all-yellow or white.
Exactly three residual broad tapered orange fire-wake strands approach the contact from lower left, their ending swallowed by burst; about 1m length, dissolving to a small number of elegant embers. Sparse short sparks and tiny glowing embers ejected from contact with varied lengths, not a dense radial line starburst. A faint wisp of warm gray vapor above burst, no heavy smoke cloud. Subtle close-fitting heat shimmer on the burst edge. A small soft warm reflection on ground only, no lava, no ground cracks, no scorch crater, no floor AOE circle. Target has no frozen pose or implied lasting control.
Text heading EXACTLY "火球击中 · 赤金迸焰"; right caption EXACTLY "接触爆燃与卷焰层次".
Render a coherent beautiful production concept, a readable ordinary targeted spell hit rather than an ultimate or large battlefield explosion.

Primary request: redesign an ICE CRYSTAL HIT, continuous in style with a single transparent pointed blue faceted crystal projectile with three swept-back fins in flight.
At chest contact the incoming pointed crystal fractures and bursts into a carefully structured three-dimensional cone/fan of transparent pale blue shards, about 85-105cm across compared with the 180cm target. A small piercing icy-white/cyan contact glint occupies less than 5% of effect; deep azure translucent crushed core behind it, never a blown-out white orb. The single incoming projectile is now BROKEN: do not leave a whole spear floating in front of target. Roughly 8-12 readable larger shards with different lengths and 15-25 tiny chips travel outward and slightly backward from contact, with physically convincing irregular broad crystal faces, fresh fracture edges, small transparent layered thickness, cool internal reflections. Broken fragments must not form a symmetrical lotus, crystalline flower, regular spiky ball or opaque giant icicles. Color #409CE5 and pale #C4DCFF with deeper azure interiors, extremely thin selective icy-white glints, no thick white outlines. Some shards blur subtly along their motion while central crystal detail is crisp. A shallow translucent frost-vapor bloom curls around the lower part of the fracture, about one third opacity, with distinct soft volumetric folds, leaving the target silhouette visible.
Exactly three pale blue residual tapered cold-flow wake strands approach from lower left, about 1m long, dissolving into sparse tiny icy flecks at impact. A delicate local air-pressure shimmer bends immediate background lines, no circular magic seal, no sphere shield. Very faint temporary crystalline frost at the immediate armor contact only; do not enclose target in ice, no immobilizing shell, no ice roots, no frozen ground path, no tall ground spikes, no gameplay damage radius ring. Small cool blue bounce on armor and pavement, no snowstorm. Contrast between hard transparent shards and soft restrained cold vapor is the key visual.
Text heading EXACTLY "冰晶击中 · 霜晶碎爆"; right caption EXACTLY "晶体破碎与冷雾层次".
Render a coherent beautiful production concept, a readable ordinary targeted spell hit, not a giant freezing ultimate.
